method: Reviewed full draft against official Korea Electrical Safety Corporation (KESCO), Korean Agency for Technology and Standards (KATS KS C 8305), and Korea Energy Agency guidelines. Verified ratings (10A/2500W vs 16A/4000W), 80% safety margin rule (2000W/3200W), 2.5sq wire thickness, circuit breaker types (MCCB vs ELCB, 15-30mA/0.03s), appliance power ratings, and maintenance schedules. All facts match official documentation.
